display.description: The Broken Milestone quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: The Broken Milestone

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
The Broken Milestone is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Good. A repaired road is a quiet promise that someone can still come home.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: The repair still needs 12 smooth stone.
missing_proof: Bring a brush from the work. A clean story needs its dust on it.
missing_target: The stone is useful, but I need you to reach the ruins near the marker first.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then the road keeps its crooked little secret.
A road marker broke near some old ruins. Without it, travelers follow bad guesses.
There is a milestone out there that stopped doing its job. I would like it corrected.

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: Trail ruins near {target_x}, {target_z}. I need a brush for the old dust and 12 smooth stone for the new face.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: The Broken Milestone is already settled.
locate_failed: The road is too quiet today. I cannot find the broken marker from here.
started: The old mark is about {distance} blocks {direction}, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a brush and 12 smooth stone so we can set the route right.
unavailable: That route is not ready for your hands yet.

lines: Did you find the broken marker, or only a reason to dislike old roads?
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
